comments.author: Alzalith
comments.body: is this recipe on MARIS yet? are we getting it at all?

comments.author: Guilder
comments.body:
As noted under the M.Gold's comments:

"It takes 10 mil check x 5, special purchase bond x 5 and gaseous drug x 5 to make orichalcum through transmutation. With Atlantis surfaced, success rate is 45%. Special purchase bond is cash only. Better get orichalcum directly somehow."

comments.author: CABlakeC
comments.body: We do have this recipe but the ingredients listed above is for Japanese server only. For us on Maris, it's different. It takes 5 Check (10 million㌦), 5 Gaseous Drug, and 5 Special Purchase Bond, the latter being a cash shop only item. Considering it has a low success rate when Atlantis is not around, that everything is consumed regardless of success or failure, and that the SPBs are rather costly, their are better ways of getting orichalcum then this...
